{{Engineer infobox}}

'''The Sarge''' is a ship [[Engineers|Engineer]] based at '''The Beach''' in the '''Beta-3 Tucani''' system. He is an anonymous former Federal Navy specialist whose work with Colonial Drones Corporation and Core Dynamics established his reputation in drone controllers and long-range support systems.<ref name="edwiki-sarge">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/The_Sarge The Sarge], Elite Dangerous Wiki; in-game description and legacy Engineer record.</ref>

He provides Grade 5 Engineering for [[Cannon|Cannons]] and four types of limpet controller. His Rail Gun services reach Grade 3.<ref name="inara-sarge">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/17/ The Sarge — Engineer], INARA; current access, location, reputation, and service record. Retrieved 11 September 2026.</ref>

The Beach is a surface Engineer facility on Beta-3 Tucani 2 b a.<ref name="inara-sarge" />

== Access requirements ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Stage
! Requirement
|-
| Discovery
| Receive a referral from [[Juri Ishmaak]] after reaching Grade 3 access plus at least one-third progress toward Grade 4.
|-
| Meeting
| Reach '''Midshipman''' or higher in the Federal Navy.
|-
| Unlock
| Deliver '''50 Aberrant Shield Pattern Analysis'''.
|}

The rank requirement concerns Federal Navy progression rather than ordinary reputation with a Federation-aligned minor faction. Aberrant Shield Pattern Analysis is Encoded Engineering data and does not use cargo space.<ref name="inara-sarge" />

{{Field note|INARA reports that station services may not appear immediately after the workshop is unlocked. Relogging should make them available.<ref name="inara-sarge" />}}

== Reputation ==

Reputation with The Sarge can be increased by:

* crafting Engineering modifications at The Beach;
* selling exploration data at The Beach; or
* handing in bounty vouchers at The Beach.<ref name="inara-sarge" />

The Sarge does not provide a direct referral to another Engineer.

The current conventional service record lists eight Cannon blueprints, Lightweight, Reinforced, and Shielded blueprints for each limpet-controller family, and five Rail Gun blueprints.<ref name="inara-sarge" />

== Operations-era services ==

The Operations update introduced ship modules and blueprints purchased with Merc Coins. Frontier describes these rewards as base modules that can be upgraded through existing Engineers.<ref name="frontier-operations">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-4-0-0 Elite Dangerous: Operations — Available Now], Frontier Developments; Operations rewards and Engineering model. Retrieved 11 September 2026.</ref>

The Sarge currently offers two additional Live-only blueprints for compatible Merc modules:

{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Module
! Blueprint
! Maximum grade
|-
| [[Cannon]]
| Force Impact
| Grade 5
|-
| Rail Gun
| Enduring Feedback
| Grade 3
|}

Enduring Feedback incorporates the Feedback Cascade effect. It can be taken to Grade 5 through [[Tod "The Blaster" McQuinn]] in the Bubble or [[Etienne Dorn]] in Colonia.<ref name="inara-enduring">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/216/ Rail Gun — Enduring Feedback], INARA; current Engineer and maximum-grade record. Retrieved 11 September 2026.</ref>

== Referral position ==

The Sarge is one of two direct referrals from [[Juri Ishmaak]]:

<pre>
Felicity Farseer
└── Juri Ishmaak
    ├── Colonel Bris Dekker
    └── The Sarge
</pre>

[[Colonel Bris Dekker]] is a parallel referral, not a prerequisite for The Sarge. The Sarge is terminal in the current referral network.<ref name="inara-sarge" />
